summary: Added target_deep_agents conditional branches to all four PM sub-agent invocation steps (3-6) in personas/ledger/src/content/2-project-manager.md using nested {{#if target_deep_agents}}...{{else}}CC content{{/if}}{{/if}} pattern.

Fixed resolveConditionals() in ai-persona-builder-DEV/src/engine/conditionals.ts to use innermost-first multi-pass resolution (negative lookahead on nested {{#if) — required for nested conditionals to produce correct output for all three targets without stray {{/if}} tokens.
Added 6 new unit tests for nested conditional resolution in tests/engine/conditionals.test.ts.
Rebuilt 81 personas. VS Code and Claude Code PM outputs are byte-identical to pre-change. Deep-agents PM output now uses task(subagent: "wp-decomposer") etc. for all four sub-agent invocations.

comments.note: resolveConditionals() in src/engine/conditionals.ts was using a simple non-greedy single-pass regex that could not correctly handle nested {{#if}} inside {{else}} branches — the innermost {{/if}} was incorrectly consumed as the closing tag for the outermost {{#if}}, leaving a stray outer {{/if}} in the output. Fixed by changing to an innermost-first multi-pass loop: the pattern now uses a negative lookahead ((?!\{\{#if\b)) so each pass only resolves blocks with no nested {{#if}} content, and the loop repeats until stable. This is a correctness fix with no behavioral change for non-nested templates.

The persona_file field description in workflow-manifest.schema.json incorrectly described the field as 'VS Code persona file' — it is actually the Claude Code file. Fixed the description as part of the schema update for persona_file_deep_agents.

summary: Reviewed conditionals.ts, conditionals.test.ts, and personas/ledger/src/content/2-project-manager.md. Algorithm is architecturally sound: innermost-first multi-pass resolution via tempered greedy token (noNestedIf) correctly handles nested {{#if}} in {{else}} branches; stabilization loop terminates in O(max nesting depth) passes with no infinite-loop risk. Doc comment is comprehensive and accurate. Tests cover 2-level nesting with all 3 meaningful branch combinations plus whitespace symmetry and edge cases. Template changes are structurally consistent across all 4 sub-agent steps; agent_slug_* variables resolve correctly to hyphenated slugs in generated output; no stray template markers in any target output.

Low priority: the algorithm's iterative design makes correctness self-evident, but a test is a good safety net.
